text.p: NWE oil products were mised on Thursday, traders said.
Gasoline ended steady to higher. Barges rose on further buying from two traders while a shut arb capped cargo prices.
Naphtha ended slightly below its $186.75 cargo deal done on Wednesday, but the backwardation in swaps widened out to $3.50.
Gas oil weakened slightly as futures waned and diffs came under pressure. Heating oil barges were quoted at July IPE +50 cents/+$1.0 fob ARA.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were largely unchanged with late trades at $85 and $85.50 fob Rotterdam after earlier deals at $85/$86. Low sulphur barges traded twice a little weaker at $94.50 fob Flushing a tonne.
High sulphur cargoes were quiet, with one seller cutting his asking price for bunker grade material by $1 to $81 fob and a second seller still asking $79 fob for his cargo.
